items.name: Puzzlin' Polokwane 2024

venue.name: Taberna Dei Ooskampus
venue.details: Side entrance next to parking lot. Follow the signs

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Polokwane competition of 2024!
This competition has a focus on holding popular events to give newer competitors an easy oppurtunity to start competing with the rest of the South African cubing community. 
The competition is open to **anyone** who knows how to solve a cube! Whether you take 20 seconds or 5 minutes to solve the 3x3 we will be happy to have you!


## Newcomers and returners

This competition will recognise both a newcomer and experienced competitor podium across all the events. Be sure to stick around for the chance to meet and compete with other cubers!

##### ALL NEW COMPETITORS
If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct.
Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp.


## Volunteers
We will require volunteers to support with running, judging and scrambling on the day. We will demonstrate the process for these duties during the new competitor tutorial, and encourage everyone to get involved. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly.



## About CubingZA
Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact) We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

##### [HR]

Ovo natjecanje organizira Udruga Speedcubing Hrvatska.
Ako trebate dodatne informacije ili želite promijeniti svoju registraciju, molimo vas da pošaljete e-mail na **kontakt@speedcubinghrvatska.hr**

Ovo natjecanje sudjeluje u službenom WCA Mjesecu Novih Natjecatelja 2024. **Proces registracije osigurava 50% mjesta za nove natjecatelje.** Novi natjecatelji su oni natjecatelji koji još nemaju WCA ID ili imaju WCA ID iz 2024. godine. Natjecatelji koji imaju WCA ID od 2023. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Svi natjecatelji i dalje moraju slijediti sve zahtjeve za prijavu kako bi se njihova prijava smatrala potpunom.

#### Prijave će se prihvačati na sljedeći način:
* 50% mjesta određenih limitom broja natjecatelja, osigurano je za nove natjecatelje.
* Na početku je za povratnike na raspolaganju 50% mjesta, određenih limitom broja natjecatelja. Prijave će se primati uobičajenim redoslijedom po principu "tko prvi , njegovo".
* Ako se više od 50% novih natjecatelja prijavi prije nego što se preostalih 50% mjesta popuni povratnicima, daljnje prijave se prihvaćaju uobičajenim redoslijedom za nove natjecatelje i povratnike u isto vrijeme.
* Ako mjesta osigurana za nove natjecatelje ne popune novi natjecatelji dva tjedna prije zatvaranja registracija, preostala mjesta, do ograničenja natjecatelja, bit će prihvaćena od registriranih povratnika.
 
Za više informacija, molimo provjerite kartice!

- - -

If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail to the **kontakt@speedcubinghrvatska.hr**.

* 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.name: German Newcomer Day 2024
items.information:
**English**

**This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Deutsch**

**Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt.

**Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:**
* 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert.
* 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar.
* Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen.
* Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1019092248614424637/1182038138156232814/WCA_Newcomer_Month_LOGO_A1_12.png?ex=65833dcd&is=6570c8cd&hm=8601e1d3b9f4839c2e67ef9936687a271a917d082791b5a0fbd068754df11b32&)

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 25% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

* 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 75% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 25% of new competitors register before 75% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

Competitors will receive a name tag.

Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered a refunded registration fee in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition.

Ξεκινά η συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς, αφιερωμένο στους νέους λάτρεις του cubing! Με μεγάλη χαρά και ενθουσιασμό ανοίγουμε την αυλαία για μια σειρά από διαγωνισμούς, όπου νέοι συμμετέχοντες θα έχουν την ευκαιρία να αναδείξουν το ταλέντο και την αγάπη τους για το cubing. Το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' θα είναι μια πρώτη ευκαιρία για τους νέους cubers να γευτούν την μαγεία του ανταγωνισμού και να γνωρίσουν την κοινότητα από κοντά. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να γίνετε μέρος αυτής της μοναδικής εμπειρίας. 
Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε για την πρόκληση και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί το πάθος για το cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες.

* Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greather than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. 
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. 

**This competition is a series competition with [Minnesota Newcomer Saturday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSaturday2024).  You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.**

items.information:
###Português

O Schoolmark Open está de volta! Com algumas mudanças e surpresas, porém com a mesma atmosfera que tornou as primeiras edições tão boas!
Algumas informações importantes:
*  É imprescindível entender as regras, conforme **[Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**
*  A competição é aberta a qualquer pessoa que deseje participar, indepentende de idade, nacionalidade, ou velocidade de resolução.
*  Além disso, a competição também é aberta a acompanhantes e espectadores.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**Atenção**: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar.**
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com))**
As inscrições deverão ser pagas **via Stripe** na aba de **Inscrever.**


###English

Schoolmark Open is back! With a few changes and surprises, but with the same atmosphere that made the first editions so great!
Some important information:
* It's essential to understand the rules, as in the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**
* The competition is open to any person that wants to participate, independent of age, nationality, or solving speed.
* Besides that, the competition is also open to guests and spectators.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**Attention**: This competition has a competitor limit. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**.
In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com)).**
Entries must be paid **through Stripe** in the **Register** tab.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

**NYU ID POLICY:** New York University requires all adults to bring a government issued ID to sign in to NYU buildings. The organizers of this competition will have to submit a list of all visitors (which includes the competitor and their adult chaperone if the competitor is a minor) to the NYU visitor system after registration has been finalized. Read more about the [NYU Visitor Policy here](https://www.nyu.edu/about/visitor-information/sponsoring-visitors.html).

**MINORS POLICY:** New York University requires chaperones for all minors participating in on-campus events. Therefore, any child under 18 in the venue must be accompanied by a parent or other adult, who will be required to bring a government issued ID and sign in. 

**GUEST POLICY:** Each competitor is allowed to bring only 1 guest. If you would like to bring additional guests, please reach out to the organizers and we will let you know if there are any extra guest slots.

items.name: Beginner Cubing Delmenhorst 2024
items.information:
**English**

We are looking forward to welcome you at the first competition in Delmenhorst and the third one in Lower Saxony!

**This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 35% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 35 spots (35% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 65 spots (65% of spots) are initially available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 35 new competitors register before 65 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 35 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Deutsch**

Wir freuen uns euch auf der ersten Competition in Delmenhorst und der dritten in Niedersachsen begrüßen zu dürfen!

**Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 35% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt.

**Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:**
* 35 Plätze (35% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert.
* 65 Plätze (65% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar.
* Wenn sich mehr als 35 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 65 Plätze von den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen.
* Wenn die 35 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

Get ready for a day of big cubes and blindfolded solving in San Jose!

## This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube.

## Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

All attendees are required to be quiet during blindfolded events, as these events require lots of concentration. If you would like to talk during a blindfolded event, please step outside of the venue first.

The registration fee for this competition is $32; however, if you have registered and paid the full fee for [BASC 56 - Bay Area Side Events Day 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC56BASED2024), you can register for this competition for a discounted fee of $20.

**IMPORTANT: For technical reasons, you will have to pay the $32 fee in full, even if you are eligible for the discounted fee.** Once you have paid the full fee for both competitions, we will issue a $12 refund to bring your total payment down to $20.

Competition Day Timing:
* The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
* Lunch will end at the scheduled time.
* Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early.
* Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.name: BASC 56 - Bay Area Side Events Day 2024
items.information:
BASC is proud to host a competition in San Jose again! Join us at Andrew P. Hill High School for a jam-packed day of speedcubin' featuring a variety of unofficial events.

The main focus of this competition will be its unofficial events, which are not sanctioned by the WCA. For more details and unofficial events registration, see the [Unofficial Events tab](#35589-must-read-unofficial-events).

## This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube.

## Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

We will be using Cubing Contests for live results for the unofficial events at this competition. See the [Live Results tab](#35619-live-results) for more information.

Competition day timing:
* The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
* Lunch will end at the scheduled time.
* Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early.
* Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

If you like big cubes and blindfolded solving, check out [BASC 57 - Big and Blind 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC57BigandBlind2024), a competition taking place in San Jose the same weekend as this one!

### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.**

All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

#### **Competition Day Timing**

* The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
* Lunch will end at the scheduled time.
* Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early.
* Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.name: Christchurch Mind Games 2024
items.information:
Christchurch Mind Games 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.name: Eagle of the East Azerbaijan 2024
items.information:
Qafqazın ən böyük şəhəri olan, qartal şəklində Azərbaycanın şərqində və Xəzərin sahilində yerləşən gözəl Bakımıza xoş gəlmisiniz! Şərq Qartalı 2024 (Eagle of the East 2024) bütün iştirakçılara açıq olan, dost mühitində keçiriləcək əyləncəli bir Rubik kubu yarışıdır. Uzun bir aradan sonra yenidən keçirilən bu ənənəvi yarışda bu il də çoxlu iştirakçı görməyi ümid edirik.

Eagle of the East 2024 yarışı [Azərbaycan Kub Assosiasiyası](https://www.facebook.com/officialACA/) tərəfindən təşkil olunur.

Welcome once again to Baku – largest city in Caucasus, beautifully situated by the eagle-like east part of Azerbaijan! Eagle of the East 2024 is a friendly and relaxed cube competition open to all who wish to participate. After a long break, we decided to arrange this traditional competition again and we are hoping for many participants also this year.

Eagle of the East 2024 competition is organized by [Azerbaijan Cube Association](https://www.facebook.com/officialACA/).

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below.

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

### LUCKY DRAW

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more!

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2024 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

All additional donations and remaining profits from this competition will be donated to the [Associated Students of the University of California (ASUC)](https://asuc.org/). 

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbUZFIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e52c4976630111f390c1af58937b15308aa64a13/image.png)

Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
